statements.status_notes: System.Security.Cryptography.Xml 8.0.0 is present only in dotnet-format's private tool directory. Static analysis of the exact dotnet-format 8.3.657409 payload bundled with SDK 8.0.422 found no reference to the affected EncryptedXml class from dotnet-format or any dependent assembly. Microsoft.Build.Tasks.Core references only SignedXml for Windows-only ClickOnce manifest signing. The Linux dotnet-format execution path therefore cannot invoke the advisory's vulnerable EncryptedXml processing.
